commentaire: Jeu de cas OCaml pour la famille du pli sur arbre binaire. type 'a arbre = Feuille | Noeud of 'a arbre * 'a * 'a arbre

equivalentes.code:
let rec somme a =
  match a with
  | Feuille -> 0
  | Noeud (g, x, d) -> somme g + x + somme d

let rec somme a =
  match a with
  | Feuille -> 0
  | Noeud (g, x, d) -> x + somme d + somme g

let rec somme t =
  match t with
  | Feuille -> 0
  | Noeud (gauche, valeur, droite) -> somme gauche + valeur + somme droite

let rec somme a =
  match a with
  | Noeud (g, x, d) -> somme g + x + somme d
  | Feuille -> 0

let rec somme (a : int arbre) : int =
  match a with
  | Feuille -> 0
  | Noeud (g, x, d) -> somme g + x + somme d

let rec somme = function
  | Feuille -> 0
  | Noeud (g, x, d) -> somme g + x + somme d

distinctes.code:
let somme a =
  let rec aux acc t = match t with
    | Feuille -> acc
    | Noeud (g, x, d) -> aux (aux (acc + x) g) d in
  aux 0 a
let rec somme a = if est_feuille a then 0 else valeur a + somme (gauche a) + somme (droite a)

let rec somme a =
  match a with
  | Feuille -> 1
  | Noeud (g, x, d) -> somme g * x * somme d

let rec somme a =
  match a with
  | Feuille -> 0
  | Noeud (g, _, d) -> 1 + max (somme g) (somme d)
